agent.description: List the agents this install is configured with.

approval.refused_one: {{count}} tool call needed approval and was refused. Rerun with --yes to allow it.
approval.refused_other: {{count}} tool calls needed approval and were refused. Rerun with --yes to allow them.
approval.title: Allow {{tool}}?

chat.argument: a single turn to run, instead of the prompt
chat.description: Talk to the agent. With no message, opens a prompt.

header.hintMenu: /help for commands · ctrl-g for the menu

chat.interrupted: interrupted. The prompt is yours again
chat.transcriptFooter: esc to close · page-up, page-down to scroll

options.json: emit one agent event per line as JSON
options.model: model id, overriding the configured default
options.new: clear the session before this turn
options.noTools: run the turn with no tools registered
options.provider: provider id, overriding the configured default
options.session: a session to continue, instead of starting one
options.workspaces: folder the workspaces live in, overriding the configured default
options.yes: run tools set to ask without asking

list.description: Show every installed environment definition and its hardening.

approve.description: Approve an extension's current files so the server may load it.

list.description: Show every installed extension and the state it is in.

revoke.description: Withdraw approval. The files stay installed but stop loading.

init.description: Configure this install: a workspace, a provider and a model.
init.heading: Setting up DarkWire.
init.listFailed: Could not list models from this endpoint. Type one instead.

efforts.default: send none at all. The provider applies its own

menu.footer: ↑↓ move · type to filter · enter choose · esc cancel

titles.deleteSession: Delete {{id}}? Everything said in it goes
titles.removeWorkspace: Detach {{id}}? The files stay where they are

program.description: A self-hosted agent that runs where your files are.

options.logLevel: one of {{levels}}; overrides --verbose (default: error, or info while serving)
options.verbose: report more of what the install is doing, not only the answer

prompt.notAnOption: “{{name}}” is not one of these. Enter numbers or names.

stopReasons.wall_timeout: stopped at the turn time cap

action.description: What to do: list, health, start, stop or restart.

sandbox.description: Inspect and manage the containers the environment service is holding open.

environment.description: Environment definition to warm an instance from.

id.description: The instance to stop or restart.

workspace.description: Registered workspace the instance belongs to.

serve.agentUnconfigured: not configured. Add a provider in the UI, or run `darkwire init`
serve.authDisabled: disabled. Anything that can reach {{host}} can drive this agent
serve.codeOnce: It works once, and stops working as soon as you set a password.
serve.description: Serve the web UI and the API on one port.
serve.firstRunBody: Open the URL above and enter this one-time code:

options.host: bind address, overriding the configured default
options.password: set or rotate the login password (or DARKWIRE_PASSWORD)
options.ui: a built UI to serve, instead of the bundled one
options.username: set the login name alongside --password (or DARKWIRE_USERNAME)
options.workspaces: folder the workspaces live in, overriding the configured default

serve.uiUnbuilt: not bundled. Serving the API only (this binary was built without the web UI)

errors.modelPinned: --model pinned the model for this run; /model cannot move it
errors.notYours: Message {{seq}} is not one of yours
errors.nowhereToMove: there is nowhere else to move them. Make another workspace first
errors.usageEffort: no such level. Pick one of {{levels}}, or default
errors.usageTemperature: usage: /temperature <a number from 0 to 2>, or /temperature default
errors.workspaceInUse_one: {{count}} session is still in {{id}}. Move it first: /workspace move {{id}} default
errors.workspaceInUse_other: {{count}} sessions are still in {{id}}. Move them first: /workspace move {{id}} default

help.agent: show agents, or move this session onto one
help.branch: fork this session here and carry on in the fork
help.context: what the next turn would send to the model
help.delete: drop the last exchange, question and answer both
help.edit: replace the last thing you said and run it again
help.effort: pick how hard this session's agent is asked to think, or name a level
help.memory: what this workspace remembers, and a key to stop it
help.model: show the models this install can reach, and move this session's agent onto one
help.new: start a fresh session and attach to it
help.regenerate: run the last turn again, discarding the answer it gave
help.session: pick a session to continue, or attach to one by key
help.tasks: the plan this session is running on, and a key to empty it
help.temperature: the sampling temperature this session's agent sends, or default to say nothing
help.transcript: everything that has been said, with nothing folded away
help.workspace: manage where new sessions land, or switch by id

keys.editLine: start of line, end of line, back, forward
keys.editWord: back a word, forward a word
keys.history: the last thing you asked, and the one before it
keys.kill: clear the line, clear to the end, delete a word
keys.stats: whether the next turn’s cost is printed
keys.tools: how the next tool’s output arrives

notes.memoryCount_one: {{count}} memory in {{path}}/, indexed in every prompt on this folder for about {{tokens}} tokens
notes.memoryCount_other: {{count}} memories in {{path}}/, indexed in every prompt on this folder for about {{tokens}} tokens
notes.memoryDisabled: {{agent}} no longer remembers, and its memory has left the prompt. The files are untouched
notes.memoryEmpty: nothing remembered yet. The first file lands in {{path}}/ when the agent uses its memory tool
notes.memoryEnabled: {{agent}} can remember again. This changes the agent, so every session on it is affected
notes.memoryOff: {{agent}} does not have the memory tool, so nothing is remembered and no memory reaches the prompt. /memory on grants it
notes.modelSet: {{agent}} now runs {{model}}, saved to your config
notes.noModels: no endpoint published a model list
notes.noTranscript: nothing to lay it over here. Every one of those rows is already on the stream
notes.nothingSaid: nothing said in this session yet
notes.nothingToMeasure: nothing to measure yet. This session has not started
notes.sampleDefault: {{agent}} now sends no {{field}} at all. The provider applies its own
notes.sampleSet: {{agent}} now sends {{field}} {{value}}, saved to your config
notes.sampleUnset: {{agent}} sends no {{field}} at all. The provider applies its own
notes.skillsEmpty: no skills yet. A folder with a SKILL.md in {{path}}/ becomes one
notes.skillsOff: {{agent}} does not have the skill tool, so no catalogue reaches the prompt and it cannot open a sheet
notes.tasksEmpty: no plan on this session. The agent writes one with its todo tool when the work needs more than a step or two
